description: This Java source file defines the PaymentWorker utility class, which provides various static methods for handling payment-related operations in the OFBiz accounting framework. These include retrieving payment methods, computing totals, and assessing applied or unapplied payment amounts.

classes.name: PaymentWorker
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for processing and retrieving payment data, such as payment methods, totals, and applied amounts within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getPartyPaymentMethodValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of maps containing payment method details for a specific party, optionally including old payment methods.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodAndRelated
methods.description: Gathers detailed payment method information, associated contact mechanisms, and related entities from an HTTP request context.

methods.name: getPaymentAddress
methods.description: Fetches the primary postal address associated with a party's payment location.

methods.name: getPaymentsTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount from a list of payment records.

methods.name: getPaymentApplied
methods.description: Determines the total amount applied to a specific payment, either actual or standard, by querying PaymentApplication entities.

methods.name: getPaymentAppliedAmount
methods.description: Returns the applied amount in the currency of the associated invoice/payment, considering currency conversions if necessary.

methods.name: getPaymentNotApplied
methods.description: Calculates the remaining unapplied amount of a payment, taking into account actual currency amounts if specified.
